component.name: The End
component.description: Returns the finished story as the artifact and a short summary as response data.
component.manifest_yaml:
extension_type: END
name: The End
description: Returns the finished story as the artifact and a short summary as response data.
tags:
  - beginner
  - end
input_ports:
  - port_name: input
    port_type: in
    artifact_type_input: text
    request_data:
      words_in_opening:
        type: integer
        description: How many words the opening had.
      words_added:
        type: integer
        description: How many words the ending added.
      model:
        type: string
        description: The model that wrote the ending.
      provider:
        type: string
        description: The model provider.
      tokens_in:
        type: integer
        description: Prompt tokens the call used.
      tokens_out:
        type: integer
        description: Completion tokens the call used.
external_out_port:
  port_name: external_out
  port_type: external_out
  artifact_type_input: text
  response_data:
    total_words:
      type: integer
      description: Words in the finished story.
    words_added:
      type: integer
      description: How many words the ending added.
    model:
      type: string
      description: The model that wrote the ending.
input_parameters: []
required_secrets: []

words_added.description: How many words the ending added.
